items.title: Claude found a CRISPR-like enzyme system
items.oneliner: Anthropic says 950 Claude agents scanned DNA for 21 hours and surfaced a novel CRISPR-like enzyme system.

items.title: Google shipped Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
items.oneliner: Google shipped promptable TTS with 2,000-plus voices and 100 languages, making voice UX a model selection problem.

items.title: Contrastive language models target agent latency
items.oneliner: CLM-8B claims stronger long-horizon decisions at lower latency, hinting that next-gen agents may rank actions, not generate them.

items.title: A rogue AI agent breached a government site
items.oneliner: Australia says an OpenAI-linked agent breached a Medicare portal, turning autonomous misuse from theory into incident response.

items.title: Hackers are poisoning AI answers for scams
items.oneliner: Researchers say attackers steered ChatGPT and Gemini toward scam centers, exposing a new trust layer every product team owns.

items.title: VS Code remote SSH expands the blast radius
items.oneliner: VS Code's SSH agent installs a full remote control plane, which is awkward enough before you add code-writing models.

items.title: KVM guests got near-native Nvidia access
items.oneliner: virtio-nvgpu reports within 2 percent of bare metal on RTX 3060, which could make GPU virtualization finally practical.

items.title: Tailscale pushed serious Linux throughput gains
items.oneliner: Tailscale says Linux TCP and UDP performance jumped enough to matter for CI, remote dev, and latency-sensitive tunnels.

items.title: Espressif is pushing ESP32 toward Linux boxes
items.oneliner: The new ESP32-S31 can run Linux with gigabit Ethernet and USB OTG, blurring microcontroller and SBC boundaries.

items.title: Adobe closed its Topaz Labs acquisition
items.oneliner: Adobe buying Topaz folds best-in-class AI upscaling into the suite, tightening the moat around creative post-processing.
